description: The specifications named by products: standards listed for a product (with what they are used for) and the standard written on each part (anodising, chromate, welding, composites ...), each with the part function, the quote and the source where there is one. Give a product ("which standards does the Pumpkin CubeSat Kit structure cite"), a part function ("which standards are used on structural parts"), or both. The function tag is derived from the wording; the standard names are as the sources print them. An empty answer means none named in the sources read.

part_function.description: Part function: structure, thermal control, power, propulsion, mechanisms, avionics, optics, protection or other. DERIVED by explicit name rules from the part names (marked function_basis "derived"), not stated by the sources.
